title: Looking at a seam from both sides

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The seam looks straight in the photo you sent. Why did you mark that sample for a closer look?
turns.zh: 你傳來的照片裡，縫線看起來很直。為什麼你還標了這件樣品，要再仔細檢查？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: That photo shows the outside of the pouch. Turn it inside out. See that little fold along the seam? The stitch caught the lining while it was folded over.
turns.zh: 那張照片拍的是袋子外側。把袋子翻過來。看到縫線旁的小摺嗎？車縫時內襯摺在一起，被縫住了。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Could the thread be too tight? That would explain why the fabric gathers just there.
turns.zh: 會不會是線拉太緊？這樣就能解釋為什麼布只在那裡皺成一團。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I stitched two scraps with that same setting. The scrap with flat lining stayed smooth, but the one with a fold gathered inside. Let's leave the setting alone for the next sample. I also want a check that won't miss what the photo missed.
turns.zh: 我用相同設定試縫了兩塊布。內襯攤平的那塊一直很平整，有摺的那塊內側才起皺。下一件樣品先不要改設定。檢查時，也別再漏掉照片看不出的問題。
